item.description: Larijani was killed alongside his son, Morteza, his aide Ali Reza Bayat and several bodyguards; Revolutionary Guard confirmed that Basij commander Gholamreza Soleimani was also killed in an Israeli strike

item.title: 'The price we paid was not enough?': Hezbollah’s core Shiite supporters turn bitter on war
item.description: Interviews with displaced Lebanese Shiites, long Hezbollah’s main support base, show rising anger that the group again dragged them into war with Israel, deepening displacement, destruction and doubts among some longtime backers

item.title: Iranians civilians are terrified by IDF bombings: 'Tehran looks like a city of the dead'
item.description: BBC and PBS reporters speak to residents of Tehran and other cities who have been living for three weeks under Israeli and American fire, and the fear and despair were evident in their words; 'Today I somehow survive, but how will I get through tomorrow?'

item.description: Son and deputy of Ali Larijani also killed in Israeli strikes; military continued strikes against Hezbollah terrorist targets across Lebanon, including weapons storage facilities, launchers and operational infrastructure
